defect.summary: Frozen dry-run compatibility path (t21r13_blind_author.py --prevalidate) crashes: t21r13_construction_gate.py has no build_gate_report, but t21r13_static_gold_audit.py and t21r13_blind_author.prevalidate call gate.build_gate_report. R10/R11 gate scripts define build_gate_report; the R13 rewrite dropped it without updating its two callers.
defect.consequence: Real construction would deterministically abort at the static gold audit stage (a required seal input per t21r13_freeze_holdout.AUDIT_FILES), burning the one-shot ledger. Repairing the frozen gate/static-audit scripts is forbidden by the construction freeze.
defect.evidence: AttributeError: module 't21r13_construction_gate' has no attribute 'build_gate_report' (t21r13_blind_author.py line 1743, invoked via scripts/t21r13_blind_author.py --prevalidate fast against exact committed contract bytes; see t21r13_prevalidate_out.txt)
